classification.difficultyReason: Form whole-secant lengths from internal and external segments, then solve a linear equation using the secant product rule.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: Two secants meet at an unlabelled external point on the right. The upper internal segment is x and its external segment is 6 cm. The lower internal segment is 8 cm and its external segment is 4 cm. Ordinary source colours are replaced by black house geometry.
spec.mathematics: Both secants share an external point; each near intersection is calculated from its line and the circle. External segment multiplied by whole secant is equal for both secants. The source drawing is schematic, not to scale.
spec.answerVisibility: Only x, 6 cm, 8 cm and 4 cm are visible in the question diagram; the supplied 2 cm answer is retained only in answer fields.

answer.worked:
The products of the external segments and whole secants are equal.
$$\begin{align*}
6(x+6)&=4(4+8)\\
6x+36&=48\\
6x&=12\\
x&=2\text{ cm}
\end{align*}$$
